name: CrewPoppy (Google Cloud)
description: Your AI crew, in your own Google Cloud. Ask it anything on the fly: the Planner reads your memory, judges the task, and picks the cheapest model on Vertex AI that fits — or none, when your memory answers by itself. The Briefer writes your morning brief. Hard caps, and a receipt for every read.

compliance.dataHandled: The briefs it writes and, later, your agents' definitions, memory and spend records — kept in a database inside a Google Cloud project of your own. It reads people and meetings from the memory poppy you installed, through AgentsPoppy, with a receipt for every read. The model that writes the brief runs on Vertex AI inside that same project; what it is sent is the brief's own material — those people and meetings — and nothing else. Nothing is copied anywhere else.

Reads people and meetings from your memory poppy, through AgentsPoppy, for the purpose named on every receipt.

Asks Gemini on Vertex AI, inside its own project, to write your brief from the material the Briefer gathered — billed to your Google Cloud at a few cents a day at most, and stopped by CrewPoppy's own daily and monthly caps before it could be more.

memory.reason: Briefs you on the meetings ahead and the people in them, from the memory you keep — the Briefer reads, it never writes.

job.reason: Runs your agents' schedules while CrewPoppy is closed — the same program, in your own project, as itself, reaching only Google.
